module.title: Fractions of a Set of Objects (FA-Maths)

gamification.instructions: Create a friendly fantasy mathematics quest for Primary learners practising fractions of a set of objects (fa-maths). Keep the story encouraging, age-appropriate, concise, and focused on effort, accuracy, and reflection.
gamification.title: Fractions Objects Quest
gamification.description: Build confidence and accuracy while mastering fractions of a set of objects (fa-maths).

defaults.subject: Mathematics - MATHS
defaults.outcome: 2.1 fraction as part of a set

activities.title: Fraction of a Set of Objects
Find number of objects of a fractional part given whole
Find whole given the fractional part and its quantity
Find quantity of fractional part given the other fractional part and its quantity
Identify the other fractional part and find its quantity, given the whole and fractional part
Find whole using the other fractional part and its quantity
Identify the other fractional part and equate to its given quantity
